scope: Five locally evaluated models. Collaborator DeepSeek/Gemini raw outcomes/configurations are unavailable here.

original_selection_policy.scope: Gemma, Qwen, Ministral, Haiku and Mistral Large main A/B/C. Historical B20, Qwen partial unguarded B and Granite excluded. Mistral Large B is the unrestricted guarded run of the 900-second transport rollout; its A/C combine the original runs with the later technical retries.
original_selection_policy.selection: Original status=ok/scored outcomes take precedence. Separate successful technical recoveries fill exact previously non-regular task IDs only. No duplicate regular result replacement.
original_selection_policy.metrics: Rec-B/Pre-B binary and Rec-S/Pre-S continuous; strict and lenient comparison. Undefined values stay undefined, with metric-specific denominators. Data Fidelity omitted as requested.
original_selection_policy.clean: Track C contains 1900 flawed plus 300 clean; repair comparisons use flawed only. Recovery is undefined for clean charts; clean preservation is separate.
original_selection_policy.resources: Retained selected episode attempt only; exclude previous failed/discarded P90 attempts and queue time. steps are executed tool actions including finish; model_calls are provider-accounted responses, not transport retries.
original_selection_policy.wall_s: Runner-recorded episode time including sandbox verification, excluding subsequent external benchmark scoring and discarded/previous attempts.
original_selection_policy.tokens: input_tokens/output_tokens preserve provider usage. total_input_tokens adds cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens for Anthropic; vLLM input_tokens already gives its reported input total. Tokenizers differ across models.
original_selection_policy.protocol: No step or episode wall limit in selected main outcomes. Guard/scheduler/provider revisions can differ and are retained per episode. Identical core scorer does not imply identical full protocol.
original_selection_policy.canonical_id: Runtime dataset instance ID; source_chart_id is the explicit source_id in the same frozen dataset, not a generated hash or run suffix.
